PATTERN_ASCENDING_SEQUENCE.name: Sequential Character Run
PATTERN_ASCENDING_SEQUENCE.description: Ascending or descending alphanumeric run of at least four characters.

PATTERN_REPEATED_RUN.name: Repeated Character Run
PATTERN_REPEATED_RUN.description: Same character repeated at least four consecutive times.

PATTERN_KEYBOARD_WALK.name: Keyboard Walk Pattern
PATTERN_KEYBOARD_WALK.description: Recognized four-or-more-key walk in a standard QWERTY keyboard layout.

PATTERN_YEAR_SUFFIX.name: Word Followed by Year Suffix
PATTERN_YEAR_SUFFIX.description: Four-digit year-like suffix (1900-2099) following a common base word.

PATTERN_COMMON_VARIANT.name: Predictable Common Password Variant
PATTERN_COMMON_VARIANT.description: Predictable modification (leetspeak, casing, or short trailing digits) of a common password.

DICT_BUNDLED_EXACT.name: Bundled Dictionary Match
DICT_BUNDLED_EXACT.description: Exact match against offline bundled dictionary.

DICT_CUSTOM_EXACT.name: Custom Dictionary Match
DICT_CUSTOM_EXACT.description: Exact match against user-supplied custom dictionary.
